name: Repeated fraud recalls or return requests against the same receiving account or originating institution
description: A receiving account, or flows from a given originating institution, attract multiple recall, return or fraud-notification requests in a short period, often followed by funds already having left.
fp: Operational errors, duplicate payments, disputed commercial transactions and a single large fraud event hitting one account can generate several recalls without mule activity.

sources.text: FATF, INTERPOL and Egmont Group, Illicit Financial Flows from Cyber-enabled Fraud (2023)
FATF, Recommendation 16 (payment transparency) revisions and Interpretive Note (2025)
FATF, Guidance on Correspondent Banking Services (2016)

links.name: Repeated fraud recalls or return requests against the same receiving account or originating institution
links.ctx: Several recalls arriving from different foreign institutions against one account is a strong indicator of a cross-border mule hop and justifies immediate restriction and reporting.
